questions.text: Define an ordinary point and a singular point of a linear second-order ODE.
State the existence theorem for power series solutions near an ordinary point.
Derive the Laplace transform of f(t) = e^{at} from the defining integral.
Solve y'' - 2y' + y = e^t, y(0) = 0, y'(0) = 1, using the Laplace transform.
Find the first four terms of the power series solution to y'' + xy = 0 about x = 0.
(2023) Use Laplace transforms to solve a system of two coupled first-order ODEs.
